categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: Commercial Intelligence and Smart Healthcare. The Commercial Intelligence segment focuses on EAS and RFID technology-based products and solutions for retail, supply chain, and smart city applications. The Smart Healthcare segment provides integrated digital healthcare solutions including hospital information systems, regional medical collaboration platforms, digital health records, and AI-driven medical services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include Electronic Article Surveillance (EAS), Radio Frequency Identification (RFID), Internet of Things (IoT), cloud computing, big data, and artificial intelligence (AI). The company develops hardware such as RFID tags, electronic shelf labels, and antennas, alongside software platforms like the E-SMART3.0 smart medical cloud ecosystem. Production involves manufacturing RFID and EAS hardware at their Cangnan production base, combined with software development using microservices and cloud-native architectures.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include large retail chains, supermarkets, apparel companies, 3C electronics stores, fresh food outlets, jewelry, logistics, municipal asset management, hospitals, regional medical groups, and healthcare institutions in China and overseas. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a strong presence in Europe, America, Middle East, Southeast Asia, and Hong Kong/Macau regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters in Zhejiang Province and production bases in Cangnan and Yangzhou. It also has subsidiaries and operations in Hong Kong, Sweden, the Netherlands, the United States, and Chile. Its products are exported to over 70 countries worldwide, including Europe, America, Middle East, and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures RFID and EAS hardware products and develops integrated software solutions, positioning itself as a solution provider and service operator in IoT and smart healthcare ecosystems.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The strategic focus is on transforming into a core technology-driven IoT company, emphasizing RFID technology innovation and expanding applications in smart retail, supply chain, and smart city sectors. R&D priorities include AI integration in healthcare, digital health data platforms, smart medical cloud services, and advanced RFID applications. The company also invests in product upgrades, intelligent anti-theft tags, and big data-enabled IoT platforms to enhance competitiveness and global market penetration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of RFID tags, EAS hardware, and smart healthcare systems, as well as software licensing and service contracts for digital healthcare platforms. The company uses a direct sales and agency model domestically and internationally. It also earns income from project-based contracts, system integration, and after-sales services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading manufacturer of EAS hard tags globally and a significant RFID technology developer. It holds a strong market position with a broad product portfolio and extensive international customer base. It competes with other RFID and smart healthcare solution providers domestically and internationally, leveraging its integrated hardware-software capabilities and strategic partnerships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 690.8 million, a 31.33% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 501.5 million, showing a 42.64% reduction in loss compared to 2023. The company’s total assets were about RMB 2.19 billion, with net assets of RMB 579.8 million. It is undergoing strategic restructuring focusing on IoT to drive future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its integrated IoT solutions combining RFID hardware and cloud-based software platforms to provide comprehensive smart retail and healthcare services. Its value proposition includes high-precision, reliable RFID and EAS products, customizable smart healthcare solutions with AI capabilities, and a strong global service network. The company differentiates itself through continuous innovation, extensive patent portfolio, and strategic collaborations to enhance operational efficiency and customer experience.
